cs.t: I ran the Strata project with this on 32gb ram 16gb AMD 7900XTX. It goes about 20tok/s off the ssd. I'm guessing 64gb would go to 40tok/s.  https://github.com/Niko1221/Strata   Quality wise its not fast enough for me to eval. I'll probably spend some tokens on it through openrouter. DeepSeek 4 flash though is a mess compared to GPT Sol 6.1.
cs.th: DeepSeek v4.1 Flash 1017 Scores 45 in Artificial Analysis

cs.t: Been running local LLMs on my 7900 XTX for months and the ROCm experience has been... rough. The fact that AMD is backing an official inference server that handles the driver/dependency maze is huge. My biggest question is NPU support - has anyone actually gotten meaningful throughput from the Ryzen AI NPU vs just using the dGPU? In my testing the NPU was mostly a bottleneck for anything beyond tiny models.
cs.th: Lemonade by AMD: a fast and open source local LLM server using GPU and NPU
